Name: Integrated Minecarts - A Minecart Expansion
Author: Jibblestein
Description:
This mod expands on the minecart functionality, adding new minecart locations, location sorting/reordering and allows all modded minecarts to be accessed from the same menu. The number of destinations per page of the menu can also be configured.

Modded and vanilla minecart locations are integrated into one paginated menu.

Many modded minecarts from multiple expansions have been integrated into the Integrated Minecart network. The other mod is still required.

[size=4][b]Minecart Menu Tweaks:[/b]
[/size][b]Configurable Destinations per page [/b]the vanilla menu had a hardcoded maximum of 5 destinations per page. This limit is now configurable via this mod. See the configuration section for more details.
[b]Next Page button relocation[/b] the vanilla menu has the Previous Page button on page 2+ was in the same position as the Next Page button on the first page, which could result in going back and forth between the first two pages if clicking quickly. The Next Page button has now been swapped with the Previous Page to avoid this and make it quicker to get to later pages of the menu.

[b]Unlocking Minecarts:[/b]
After repairing the minecarts, you will need to have visited the map that the minecart is on at least once before it will show up in the destination menu.

If minecarts from other mods have unlock conditions already, those will still be required before the minecarts will work.

[b][size=4]Configuration: [/size][/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][b] is recommended for best experience.

[/b]Installing this mod will have all compatible minecarts enabled by default with the Farm minecart first, then vanilla minecarts in alphabetical order including the ones added from this mod. Then modded minecarts are listed in the order as they were added to this mod. This mod can be used without configuration, but the following options are available if desired.

The name of the config setting in GMCM is shown below, the setting in the config file should be the same with no spaces unless otherwise specified.

[b][size=4][CP] Integrated Minecarts Folder / Integrated Minecarts (CP Component) in GMCM
[/size][/b]
[b]General Settings Section - Applies to all minecarts[/b]

[b]Numbering: [/b]This enables/disables enumeration of the destinations in the minecart menu e.g. "1. Farm" when enabled or "Farm" when disabled

[b]Price to Ride[/b]: This sets the price for riding on the minecarts. Leave blank or set to 0 to disable

[b]Destinations Per Page: [/b]Controls how many destinations are listed per page of the minecart menu. The menu will not scale to screen size if set to too many destinations, just reduce the number until all destinations are on screen again.

[b]Separate Ginger Island Carts:[/b] Moves the Ginger Island minecarts to a separate network so they can only be reached from other minecarts on the island. Works with Polycart's Expa option.

[b]Move Next and Previous to Top: [/b]Moves the Next and Previous buttons of the minecart menu to the top of the list. Recommended for people that use gamepads/controllers.

[b][size=3]Destination Order Section - Controls the order in which the destinations show up in the minecart menu[/size][/b]
[size=2]The options are named 1 to n (n being the maximum number of minecarts) both in GMCM and the config file, you can select a destination for each number.

The options in this section determine the positioning of the destinations in the minecart menu. The selected destination will be moved to the corresponding numbered position in the list. Selections use the MinecartID, see the Minecart Enabled section for each minecart ID. Check the tooltips for the source mod and minecart location.

E.g. From the config file:

[code]"1.": "IntegratedFarm", //Sets Farm minecart to position 1 in the list
"2.": "Bus", ﻿ ﻿ ﻿//Sets Bus minecart to position 2 in the list
[/code][b]
Additional notes:[/b]
[list]
[*][size=2]Each destination must be set to a number.[/size]
[*][size=2]If a destination is not configured to a position, the location will be set to the first position.[/size]
[*][size=2]If a destination is set to multiple positions, the highest number will be used.[/size]
[*][size=2]If not using a particular mod, set the corresponding setting to Disabled to prevent "[i]Can't move record" warnings[/i] from showing in the logs. This is optional and the warning messages are harmless.[/size]
[*][size=2]There is an optional content and config file that has only vanilla minecarts from this mod enabled. Then you can enable specific mods as required.[/size]
[/list]
[/size][b][size=3]Minecart Changes Enabled Section - Contains toggles to enable/disable minecarts and changes added by this mod, also contains mod specific settings
[/size][/b]Each setting in this section will be in the format Enable<MinecartId> in the config file, or just <MinecartId> in GMCM
[b]For minecarts added by this mod:[/b]
[size=2]If a minecart is disabled, it removes the destination from the minecart menu and removes the minecarts from the map.[/size]

[b]For minecarts from other mods:[/b]
[size=2]Mainly used for disabling changes for mods that you are not using or in the event there are mod conflicts.[/size]
[size=2]If a minecart is disabled, this mod's changes (enumeration, pricing, and reordering) will be disabled.
Unless disabled in the other mod, the other mod's minecart will be unmodified and will still show up in the minecart menu out of order (usually in the last position).[/size]

[size=2]Options are listed by minecart ID, matching the destination order option. See tooltips in GMCM for the source mod.[/size]

[b][size=3]Mod Specific options:[/size][/b]
[b]Stardew Valley Expanded - Mountain: [/b]As SVE moves the Mines entrance further away, the Mountain minecart adds a minecart to the Mountain for easier access to Robin's house and the Lake.
[b]Stardew Valley Expanded - [/b][b]Move Mountain to Adventurer's Guild: [/b]If using the SVE option to move the Mines entrance back to the original location, use Move Mountain to Adventurer's Guild to move the Mountain minecart to the Adventurer's Guild. The Mountain minecart must be enabled for this to work.

[b]Visit Mount Vapius - Hamlet to Railroad: [/b]Adds the Railroad destination to the VMV minecart network to make it easier to get back to SDV from VMV.

[b][size=3]Farm Minecart Settings - All settings related to the Farm minecart

[/size]Global settings
Jibb.Farm: [/b]Enables/Disables the Farm minecart
[b]Farm Minecart Name (Jibb.Farm.Name in config file): [/b]Allows for customization of the farm minecart name. Defaults to "Farm".

[b]Supported Farm Map settings[/b]
All supported farm maps listed in the [b]Supported Farm Maps[/b] section above have their own sections in GMCM. Each supported farm will have at least 3 options FarmCartStyle, X Coordinate, and Y Coordinate. Certain maps will have extra options as necessary.

[size=2][b]<FarmMap>FarmCartStyle: [/b]Sets the style of the Farm Minecart for the relevant Farm Map. Use Cart for open areas. Use CartEntrance if setting into a wall. Use CartEntranceNarrow if CartEntrance is too wide.

[b]<FarmMap>FarmX/Y Coordinate: [/b][/size]Used together to set the position of the Farm minecart on the relevant Farm Map. (0,0) is the top left corner of the Farm map. You can find your current coordinates by typing "debug printplayerpos" or "debug ppp" into the SMAPI console, which will return your current Tile coordinates and Map coordinates, you will need to use the Tile coordinates. Another option is to use mods like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541]Lookup Anything[/url] with Tile Lookups enabled to check coordinates. Otherwise, you can adjust relative to the default position.

[b][size=3]Custom Farm[/size][/b]
If a farm map is not listed in the Supported Farms section, use the Custom Farm settings.

[size=2][b]Use Custom Farm Map[/b]: Enables/Disables the use of the Custom Farm settings. Enabled by Default, only needs to be disabled for troubleshooting purposes[/size]

[b][size=3]Farm specific options:[/size][/b]

[b]Farm Replacement: [/b]Some custom Farm maps have an option to replace one of the default farms. For supported maps, there will be a Farm Replacement option that needs to match the map being replaced by the Farm mod.

[b][size=3]Custom Minecarts:[/size][/b]

Starting in version 4.6.0, custom carts have been added. These can be configured to be placed on any map (including unsupported mods). The map name needs to be known.
The following configurations are available and all need to be configured for the minecart to work.

[b]Enable CustomCarts:
[/b]This enables the usage of custom carts, must be on for the individual carts to be used.

Each custom cart has the following set of configurations:

[b]Enablejibb.CustomCart<n>: [/b]Enables the specific custom minecart

[b]CustomCart<n>.Name: [/b]Specifies the name of the minecart that shows in the minecart menu

[b]CustomCart<n>.Map: [/b]Specifies the name of the map for the destination of this minecart. It is recommended to use[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541]Lookup Anything[/url][b] [/b]with Tile Lookups enabled to check the map name

[b]CustomCart<n>Style: [/b]Sets the style of the custom minecart. Use Cart for open areas. Use CartEntrance if setting into a wall. Use CartEntranceNarrow if CartEntrance is too wide.

[b]CustomCart<n>X/Y: [/b]Used together to set the position of the custom minecart on the specified map. (0,0) is the top left corner of the map. You can find your current coordinates by typing "debug printplayerpos" or "debug ppp" into the SMAPI console, which will return your current Tile coordinates and Map coordinates, you will need to use the Tile coordinates. Another option is to use mods like[b] [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541]Lookup Anything[/url][b] [/b]with Tile Lookups enabled to check coordinates. Otherwise, you can adjust relative to the default position. 

[b]v2.4.1 for SDV v1.5.6 and below:[/b]
Configuration for destination order can also be configured in GMCM. config files can be preserved between versions to keep ordering.

Each destination is assigned a number to position it in the minecart menu, sorted lowest to highest.
A blank option is available at the top of the dropdown menu to remove ordering, this will place the destination after the ordered ones and all unordered ones will be sorted alphabetically as default.

Known Issues:
[/b][u][b]Unlocking RSV Minecarts:[/b][/u]
When unlocking the RSV Minecarts for the first time, if you open the minecart before the in-game time changes, it will only be able to go to the RSV stops. After waiting for the in-game time to change, all destinations will be shown. This is a limitation of Content Patcher.

[u][b]Yellow warning messages
[/b][/u]Occasionally, yellow warning messages will pop up in the logs related to this mod when interacting with minecarts.
These are just a warning message that shows up if the referenced Minecart isn't unlocked or the associated mod is not installed. It is safe to ignore.
Please don't report warning messages unless something is actually wrong. ContentPatcher doesn't allow me to check if something exists before trying to make a change to it, which is the main cause of most, if not all the warning messages.

You can set the destination to "Unused' to prevent the messages from coming up.
There is an optional config file with all modded minecarts disabled to make this easier.
[u][b]
Building Texture Glitches with SVE in non-English games:[/b][/u]
When playing with SVE in a non-English language, you may see building textures being broken (seems to affect upgraded/fixed/damaged buildings) 

This is fixed in ContentPatcher 2.1.3-alpha+.

[b][u]Bush covering Special Orders Board
[/u][/b]Not sure what causes it, but some people have run into the issue where there is a bush covering up the special orders board when it gets unlocked. One way to fix this is to install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6304?tab=description]Destroyable Bushes[/url] and destroy the bush with an axe.
